items.title: Show HN: Practical Data: a Chrome extension that conditionally shades web tables
items.summary: Practical Data is a Chrome extension that turns `<table>`s on the web into data visualizations by way of conditional formatting. It makes it easy to see patterns in the data in front of you. Importantly, it uses a decision model (like Jev) behind the scenes to get around the gotchas normally associated with this, like "green-to-red scale, but high numbers for this column are actually bad", like cost increases, or batter strikeouts, etc.
